description: This Java class implements a singleton that converts exceptions into acknowledgements with a default HTTP status code, specifically INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, for generic exceptions.

classes.name: DefaultExceptionToAcknowledgementConverter
classes.description: A singleton class that extends ExceptionToAcknowledgementConverter, providing a default mapping of exceptions to HTTP status codes.

methods.name: getStatusCodeForGenericException
methods.description: Overrides the method to return HttpStatusCode.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR for generic exceptions.
